text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that ties the ayah to the prior failed confession

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: verification/anterior particle before the perfect verb

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens 34:53 as continuation and evidence rather than a detached report. It pulls the late claim of belief in 34:52 into the narrator's counter-record, so the next words are heard as explanation for why that claim fails. Because it is fused in the first beat with {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}), connection and verification arrive together as a clipped boundary device before the heavier denial verb: the ayah begins by joining the confession to its exposed history.

topics.headline: connected counter-record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins as evidence against the prior confession, not as a detached new report.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction begins the anterior disbelief clause and links it to the prior discourse.

topics.headline: compact opening bundle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that connection and certification enter as one clipped opening beat before the heavier denial verb.
topics.reason: QAC splits the visible conjunction from the following particle, while the rows rightly note their pronounced opening bundle.

words.gloss_range: verification particle certifying the following perfect as prior fact

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conjunction linking clauses or discourse beats

words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) certifies the following perfect verb as an already-realized fact. The denial is not inferred from the present scene; it is placed on record before the ongoing casting clause begins. In the opening bundle with {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}), the particle becomes the hinge from late self-presentation in 34:52 to chronological correction in 34:53.

topics.headline: certified anterior denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prior denial is grammatically certified before the ayah describes ongoing projection.
topics.reason: The particle stands before a perfect verb in the first clause, licensing realization, confirmation, and anterior force.

words.gloss_range: completed collective refusal governed by a pronoun complement
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, refusal, ingratitude, and repudiation; local perfect with a governed pronoun selects culpable refusal of a known referent
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}) presents the group as having already completed refusal before the present-tense projection begins. Its plural morphology keeps the same speakers from 34:52 in view without renaming them, while the prepositional complement {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) makes the refusal targeted rather than abstract. The covering/denial field sharpens the irony: after covering over the recognized referent, they proceed to speak forcefully about {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}), a domain defined by hiddenness.

topics.headline: completed collective refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers carry a settled prior liability before their current claims are heard.
topics.reason: The perfect active 3mp form, under the preceding verifier, makes completed collective denial the first clause's core action.

topics.headline: refusal with governed referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is aimed at a specific discourse referent, not left as a vague condition.
topics.reason: The verb is locally governed with a prepositional pronoun complement, matching refusal formula rows without requiring a direct object.

topics.headline: covering pressure before unseen speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an irony between covered recognition and later speech about what is hidden, while local sense remains denial/refusal.
topics.reason: The covering image is valid root pressure, but the local form and complement select religious refusal, not a non-religious covering branch.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus 3ms pronoun marking the specific referent refused
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) binds the refusal to a compact 3ms referent instead of letting disbelief float as a general state. The suffix reaches back to the same truth or message claimed in 34:52, so the identical compact object stands under opposed stances: claimed belief there, prior refusal here. Its compression also prepares the move from an unnamed denied referent to the named hidden domain {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}) later in the ayah.

topics.headline: compact refused referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same unnamed referent from the prior claim is now exposed as the object of earlier refusal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffix to the same masculine singular truth or message as 34:52 and makes it the complement of the refusal verb.

topics.headline: from hidden pronoun to named domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural move from a compact denied referent to the later named unseen domain.
topics.reason: The row describes a coherent sequence within the ayah and is supported by the later governed unseen phrase.

words.gloss_range: temporal source preposition in the first distance phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) turns {{ar:قَبْلُ}} ({{tr:qablu}}) into a temporal source phrase. The point is not a loose earlierness but a starting edge of prior time from which the denial is judged. As the first of two matching source prepositions, it sets up the ayah's double removal: refusal from before, then casting from a far place.

topics.headline: prior time as source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that prior denial is located from an earlier source-point, not merely tagged as earlier.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the temporal noun and forms the temporal complement of the denial verb.

topics.headline: first half of double removal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah aligns time-distance with later source-distance through repeated prepositional structure.
topics.reason: Both occurrences govern source phrases: this one temporal, the later one spatial and epistemic.

words.gloss_range: built temporal noun closing the first beat with priorness
words.root_gloss_range: facing, receiving, acceptance, priorness, and before-ness; local construction selects prior time while leaving acceptance as contrast
words.prose: {{ar:قَبْلُ}} ({{tr:qablu}}) closes the first beat by making priorness the landing point of the denial clause. Its built, complementless form lets the before-now contrast remain compact and context-dependent. The root range includes facing and acceptance, but local grammar selects temporal priorness; that unchosen acceptance field still helps the reader feel that the road not taken was reception rather than refusal. Together with final {{ar:بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:baʿīdin}}), it frames the ayah in distance: before in time and far in standpoint.

topics.headline: compact priorness closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first beat lands on compact priorness, making earlier refusal the platform for what follows.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the preceding preposition and used adverbially as the temporal close of the first clause.

topics.headline: before-ness against acceptance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the selected sense is before-ness, while the root's receiving/acceptance field sharpens refusal as the road not taken.
topics.reason: Local grammar selects temporal priorness, so acceptance cannot replace the sense; it survives only as contrastive root pressure.

topics.headline: prior refusal in distance frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that temporal priorness joins final remoteness to frame the speakers as distant from acceptance and from knowledge.
topics.reason: The rows tie the local temporal phrase to refusal, final remoteness, and the following 34:54 recurrence without contradicting the local parse.

words.gloss_range: second conjunction opening the ongoing casting clause while preserving subject continuity
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) at word 7 opens a new finite clause without breaking the subject line from {{ar:كَفَرُوا۟}} ({{tr:kafarū}}). It lets the second clause be both coordinated action and circumstantial portrait: the same group who had refused are now depicted as casting. The light reset matters structurally, because it shifts the scene from certified past record to ongoing visible behavior.

topics.headline: bridge into ongoing depiction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah moves from completed denial into a separate but continuous ongoing speech-act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second clause as coordinated with the first and controlled by the same subject.

words.gloss_range: ongoing collective projectile speech governed through prepositional complements
words.root_gloss_range: throwing, hurling, casting, expelling, and verbal accusation; local imperfect selects forceful projected speech toward an inaccessible domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: prepositional phrase naming the unseen domain of casting

words.prose: {{ar:يَقْذِفُونَ}} ({{tr:yaqdhifūna}}) changes the ayah from settled denial to ongoing collective projection. The imperfect and plural ending keep the speakers active, while the governed phrase {{ar:بِٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:bi-l-ghaybi}}) makes the unseen a mediated domain rather than a possessed object. The root's hurling force makes their speech feel like projectiles, not careful testimony; that force is intensified by rare-root pressure and by contrast with authorized truth-casting in 21:18 and 34:48. Form I also keeps the projection one-directional, not a reciprocal exchange of accusations. The passive variant noted in the rows is useful as contrast only: the local canonical form keeps them as throwers, while the variant exposes how the same root can rebound onto them as patients.

topics.headline: ongoing collective projection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that conjectural speech is presented as continuing agency by the same group, not as one past slip.
topics.reason: The imperfect active 3mp form, joined to the previous clause, licenses ongoing collective agency.

topics.headline: mediated unseen domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unseen is the mediated domain of projection, not an object the speakers grasp.
topics.reason: The verb instance has no direct object and takes the governed unseen phrase through a preposition.

topics.headline: forceful speech as hurling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the violence of the speech image: their words are hurled toward hidden reality rather than offered as careful knowledge.
topics.reason: The local complement selects verbal projection while preserving the root's hurling image and rare harsh distribution.

topics.headline: passive variant as role contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a variant reading can reverse the role from throwers to thrown ones, while the local canonical form keeps them agents.
topics.reason: The accepted variant is useful for contrast, but it does not control the canonical active imperfect parse used locally.

topics.headline: reversed authorized casting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this casting is the negative counterpart to authorized truth-casting in 21:18 and 34:48.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels support a contrast between divine or truth-bearing casting and unsupported projection toward the unseen.

topics.headline: one-directional projection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form presents a one-way projection at the unseen rather than mutual accusation.
topics.reason: The local Form I imperfect is active and not a reciprocal form.

words.gloss_range: preposition mediating the relation between casting and the unseen domain
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small grammatical hinge that keeps {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}) from becoming a simple object in their possession. It makes their act a relation to a domain: at, about, or against the unseen, but not mastery of it. Because this governed phrase comes before {{ar:مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:min makānin baʿīdin}}), the ayah first names the target-domain and only then reveals the disqualifying source.

topics.headline: relation rather than possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the unseen is grammatically mediated as a domain of projection, not possessed as an object.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the definite unseen noun the governed complement of the casting verb through this preposition.

topics.headline: domain before source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah names the target-domain before revealing the remote source of the claim.
topics.reason: The governed unseen phrase precedes the final source phrase in the second clause.

words.gloss_range: definite governed unseen domain targeted by their projected speech
words.root_gloss_range: absence, hiddenness, unseen reality, and what lies beyond perception; local definite gerund names the recognized unseen domain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}) names the recognized unseen domain, not an indefinite hidden item. Governed by the preceding preposition, it is the field their speech reaches only through mediated casting. The hiddenness image makes the epistemic breach plain: they launch words where direct access is absent, unlike faithful trust in the unseen in 2:3 and unlike divine knowledge of the unseen in 34:3 and 34:48. Its position before {{ar:مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:min makānin baʿīdin}}) delays the verdict, so the reader first hears the claimed domain and then the remoteness of the claimants.

topics.headline: recognized unseen domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speech targets the known category of unseen reality, not an unspecified hidden item.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive after the preposition, and governed as the domain of the casting verb.

topics.headline: hiddenness exposes evidence breach
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the evidentiary breach: forceful claims are launched toward what lies beyond the speakers' perception.
topics.reason: The hidden-from-perception sense is selected by the local casting frame and reinforced by the final remote-source phrase.

topics.headline: faith and knowledge inverted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a domain associated with faithful trust and divine knowledge is here assaulted by prior deniers (2:3; 34:3; 34:48).
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references where the unseen belongs to trust or divine knowledge, contrasting with the local projectile frame.

topics.headline: target before discrediting source
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the sequencing: the ayah first displays the domain of their claim, then exposes their remote standpoint.
topics.reason: The unseen phrase occupies the middle beat before the final source phrase completes the evaluation.

words.gloss_range: source preposition opening the final remote-standpoint phrase
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) opens the final source phrase and makes location the judgment on the casting act. It does more than introduce {{ar:مَّكَانٍ}} ({{tr:makānin}}): it marks the standpoint from which the speech proceeds and the separation that disqualifies it. Repeating the earlier {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) aligns the ayah's two removals, while the source-question of 34:52 is answered here by {{ar:مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:min makānin baʿīdin}}).

topics.headline: source of the casting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final phrase diagnoses the standpoint from which the claim is launched.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the place noun as a source complement of the casting verb and carries separation pressure.

topics.headline: time and source aligned
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated prepositional structure aligning prior-time distance with remote-source distance.
topics.reason: The first occurrence governs the temporal phrase and this one governs the remote source phrase.

topics.headline: source-question answered
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 34:53 answers the source-question of 34:52 by naming a remote source-place.
topics.reason: The boundary row gives the concrete prior reference and the local phrase supplies the answer.

words.gloss_range: indefinite source-place that functions as standpoint and is specified by remoteness
words.root_gloss_range: being, occurrence, establishment, place, position, and locus; local noun of place selects source-standpoint rather than mere coordinates

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: source preposition used temporally and spatially

words.prose: {{ar:مَّكَانٍ}} ({{tr:makānin}}) is an indefinite genitive source-locus after {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), not the object of casting. Its identity matters less than the adjective that follows: the place is defined by being {{ar:بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:baʿīdin}}). The place-root field lets the noun function as standpoint, the locus from which their speech exists, not merely coordinates. Because the source phrase comes after {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}), the reader first hears their claimed domain and then discovers the remote position that discredits it; the same remote-place phrase also echoes failed reception in 41:44 and the immediately prior boundary in 34:52.

topics.headline: indefinite source-place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the place is not the object of casting; it is the source-locus whose defining feature is remoteness.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the source preposition and qualified by the following adjective.

topics.headline: place as standpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that location functions as epistemic standpoint, while the local noun remains a concrete place/locus form.
topics.reason: The place/position senses are locally supported by the source role, but abstract being does not replace the place noun's local function.

topics.headline: remote phrase as closing formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same remote-place formula moves from failed reception in 41:44 and 34:52 into failed claim-making here.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete inter-ayah comparisons and are coherent with the final phrase's local source role.

words.gloss_range: qualifying adjective that makes remoteness the final verdict on the source
words.root_gloss_range: distance, remoteness, exclusion, alienation, and unlikely access; local adjective seals the source-place as remote
words.prose: {{ar:بَعِيدٍ}} ({{tr:baʿīdin}}) supplies the final word and the decisive content of the closing noun phrase. Agreement locks remoteness onto {{ar:مَّكَانٍ}} ({{tr:makānin}}), while the qualitative adjective makes distance a stable property of the source rather than a measured coordinate. The word carries spatial, epistemic, and likelihood pressure together: their speech about {{ar:ٱلْغَيْبِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaybi}}) comes from a position too remote for access. Its repetition from the remote-place phrase in 34:52 and its parallel with 41:44 make remoteness the boundary verdict, now shifted from failed reaching to unreliable projection. At the same boundary, their quoted self-presentation in 34:52 gives way to third-person counter-record in 34:53, so the final remoteness belongs to an exposed history rather than to their own framing.

topics.headline: remoteness as final verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends by making remoteness the decisive quality of the speakers' source.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the place noun and closes the ayah, so its qualitative content seals the phrase.

topics.headline: distance as access judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that distance is not only geography; it marks exclusion from credible access to the unseen.
topics.reason: The adjective's range includes remoteness and likelihood pressure, and the local unseen frame selects spatial-epistemic access limitation.

topics.headline: repeated remote boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase repeated from 34:52 and paralleled in 41:44 shifts from failed reaching or reception to unreliable projection.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete boundary and cross-passage references that support the repeated remote-place verdict.

topics.headline: confession replaced by record
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the boundary strips control from the speakers by moving from their confession in 34:52 to third-person exposure in 34:53.
topics.reason: The boundary rows describe a coherent register and time shift also visible in the opening verified perfect and ongoing imperfect clause.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction وَيَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ ties ق ذ ف, غ ي ب, ك و ن, and ب ع د to the prior ك ف ر/ق ب ل clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Prior rejection establishes a stance from which speech behaves like a projectile: it is launched across a gap toward a domain concealed from sight and knowledge, while the location phrase makes lack of contact part of the claim-making mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Denial supplies the prior epistemic closure from which the later assertions issue.
Temporal precedence makes the closure anterior rather than a reaction formed at the final scene.
Physical throwing supplies trajectory, separation, and an attempted impact across space.
Concealment from eyes or knowledge makes the alleged target unavailable for inspection.
The locative noun turns epistemic standing into an explicit position.
Non-proximity supplies the gap between speaker and alleged object.

changed_reading.before: They disbelieved earlier and now make unsupported statements about the unseen from far away.
changed_reading.after: Their earlier rejection is the launch position for projectile-like assertions aimed into concealed reality despite having no observational contact with it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَقْذِفُونَ permits a speech-attack branch, while بِٱلْغَيْبِ and بَعِيدٍ can mark an absent target and lack of confrontation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The casting can be verbal injury rather than neutral speculation: speech attacks what is absent from hearing or view, and distance protects the speakers from direct encounter with the target or evidence.

activation_trace.role: Verbal throwing supplies accusation, insult, or reputational injury as the action.
Speaking of one who is absent supplies the offstage target of the attack.
Distance removes face-to-face correction and makes the attack one-sided.
Covering supplies the accompanying suppression of what would expose the accusation.

changed_reading.before: The clause describes conjectural talk about hidden matters.
changed_reading.after: It can also depict remote verbal assault: labels are hurled at an absent or unseen target while contrary evidence remains covered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن قَبْلُ and مِن مَّكَانٍ بَعِيدٍ frame the focus between an earlier ق ب ل moment and a present remote position.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal word activates facing and reception: what was previously available for encounter was not received, and that refusal has become the distance from which later claims are launched.

activation_trace.role: Facing supplies an earlier relation of encounter behind the temporal surface.
Reception with assent supplies the live possibility that the earlier encounter required but did not obtain.
Refusal of truth blocks that reception.
The resulting non-proximity is the later condition of the speakers.
Throwing replaces direct encounter with action attempted across the distance.

changed_reading.before: Past disbelief and present conjecture are two adjacent faults.
changed_reading.after: Present remote assertion is the afterlife of a refused earlier encounter: having declined reception when facing it, they now substitute throwing across distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening denial of the Hour is set against knowledge in which the hidden is disclosed and not even the smallest thing escapes. The focus speakers therefore occupy not merely a far location but a position categorically unlike the precise knowledge their claims imitate.

activation_trace.role: The focus action remains a projection that presumes a reachable target.
The same denial is attached to the categorical claim that the Hour will not arrive.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the contrasting condition of genuine access.
The concealed domain is explicitly the object of that genuine knowledge.
Absence and escape are negated, sharpening the contrast with the speakers' remoteness.

structural_cues: 34:3 places denial of the Hour beside the Knower of the unseen and the assertion that no particle escapes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, exact hidden knowledge, and negated escape; I infer that 34:53 exposes a counterfeit performance of that knowledge. A live alternative is that 34:3 only supplies doctrinal content, not an epistemic contrast.

changed_reading.before: The speakers conjecture because the unseen is remote.
changed_reading.after: They counterfeit comprehensive knowledge: categorical denial is launched from a position that lacks the exact, non-escaping access attributed to the true knower.

context_deltas.mechanism: A concealed fact becomes knowable through a mundane support failure: the body falls, and the hidden beings' ignorance of the unseen becomes manifest. This supplies a material test for the focus's remote claims: contact with consequences, not confident projection, reveals whether hidden knowledge was real.

activation_trace.role: The focus target is what lies beyond sight or ordinary knowledge.
A noisy, unstable fall supplies the material event that breaks the false appearance.
Emergence into visibility supplies the transition from presumed knowledge to exposed ignorance.
Hidden beings make the failed claim to hidden knowledge especially pointed.
The concealed domain is exactly what their prolonged labor proves they did not know.

structural_cues: In 34:14 an earth-creature consumes the support, the body falls, and only then does the jinn's ignorance of the unseen become evident.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed death, support erosion, collapse, and disclosure; I infer a test-by-contact that critiques 34:53's distance. A live alternative is that the episode only limits jinn knowledge without modeling the later speakers.

changed_reading.before: Remote assertions are wrong because their subject is hidden.
changed_reading.after: Remote assertions evade the material contact that could test them; hidden ignorance is disclosed when an ordinary support relation finally collapses into view.

context_deltas.mechanism: Saba moves from unacknowledged gift through a request that distance be produced to fragmentation into scattered pieces and reports. The focus's distant place can therefore be an enacted historical and social condition generated by refusal, not merely the neutral location of a mistaken speaker.

activation_trace.role: Failure to acknowledge benefaction supplies the specific kind of rejection driving the sequence.
An existing linkage between endpoints supplies the connected travel network that precedes estrangement.
Causing separation turns distance into something requested and produced.
Becoming material for later reports supplies temporal remoteness after communal destruction.
Tearing into dispersed pieces supplies the social geography of that remoteness.
Recognition of benefit marks the counter-disposition that would have preserved connection.

structural_cues: 34:15-19 runs from a good settlement and commanded gratitude through refusal, replacement, safe connected routes, a request for longer distances, and total dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence connection, ingratitude, requested distance, and fragmentation; I infer that 34:53's remote standpoint can be the accumulated result of refusal. A live alternative is that the Saba narrative is only an analogy of punishment, not the genealogy of the focus phrase.

changed_reading.before: The distant place is an external epistemic disadvantage.
changed_reading.after: Distance is also produced history: refusal asks connection to be stretched until a community becomes fragments and hearsay, the very standpoint from which remote claims persist.

context_deltas.mechanism: A conjecture becomes effective because people follow it, despite lacking compelling authority. The focus projectile can thus travel socially: speculative speech gains apparent confirmation through uptake and organizes doubt without acquiring truth.

activation_trace.role: Projection supplies an image for a claim sent outward toward recipients as well as toward a hidden object.
Realization in action supplies the sense in which the conjecture comes to look confirmed.
Uncertain imagining supplies the conjectural content that precedes uptake.
Following behind supplies the transmission mechanism that makes the conjecture effective.
The explicit absence of compelling proof separates social efficacy from evidentiary force.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty name the unstable state in which uptake operates.

structural_cues: 34:20 says Iblis's conjecture was realized over them because they followed him; 34:21 immediately denies that he possessed authority over them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, following, apparent realization, and no authority; I infer a social arrow from adoption to efficacy rather than from truth to assent. A live alternative is that the realization is only predictive, not performative.

changed_reading.before: They throw guesses at a hidden object from afar.
changed_reading.after: Their guesses also travel through followers: uptake lets an unauthoritative conjecture organize conduct and masquerade as confirmation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Affluent settlement leaders repeatedly refuse warning, while wealth and children are explicitly denied the power to bring anyone near. The focus location can therefore be a status-conditioned standpoint: privilege creates confidence and insulation but not nearness to truth or judgment.

activation_trace.role: Place permits the remote standpoint to carry social position as well as physical location.
Expansive ease supplies the social condition that releases elites into categorical refusal.
Their privileged speech culminates in explicit rejection of what was sent.
The negated power to bring near exposes the failure of material status to close the decisive gap.
Near rank or standing supplies the status relation that wealth cannot purchase.

structural_cues: 34:34 generalizes elite refusal across warned settlements; 34:35 gives their wealth-and-children confidence; 34:37 denies that those assets bring them near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affluent refusal and failed material nearness; I infer that the focus's location includes social insulation. A live alternative is that wealth explains arrogance but does not specify the meaning of distance in 34:53.

changed_reading.before: The speakers are remote because the unseen is inaccessible.
changed_reading.after: They may also speak from a socially elevated but spiritually remote position: privilege insulates assertion while failing to confer any real nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly instantiates the focus's speech-attack branch as a barrage of labels: fabricated lie, madness, truth-turned falsehood, and sorcery. The later notice that they possessed no books to study makes these not competing explanations grounded in inquiry but projectiles used to keep arrived evidence at a distance.

activation_trace.role: Verbal throwing anchors the model in accusation and reputational attack.
Inventing a falsehood supplies the first hostile explanation assigned to the messenger.
Attributing lying supplies the explicit accusatory force of that label.
Reason imagined as covered supplies the alternative label of madness.
A lie diverted from truth supplies another projectile cast at the recited signs.
Fabrication repeats the earlier accusation after clear signs have arrived.
Diversion and deception supply the final relabeling of the truth.
The negated practice of sustained textual study marks the absence of an evidentiary basis for the barrage.

structural_cues: 34:8 offers lie or madness; 34:43 repeats fabricated falsehood and clear sorcery when truth arrives; 34:44 denies prior books they could have studied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated labels and the negated study claim; I infer that label substitution functions to repel direct engagement. A live alternative is that each label records a separate objection rather than a coordinated distancing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The casting is generic conjecture about hidden matters.
changed_reading.after: It is concretized as serial accusatory relabeling: when evidence comes near, hostile names are fired at it from a standpoint untouched by study.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commanded counter-movement is to leave undifferentiated collective speech, stand in pairs or alone, and let thought turn repeatedly over a familiar companion. That procedure closes observational and social distance, directly testing the madness label instead of casting it remotely.

activation_trace.role: The focus gap supplies the condition that the reflective procedure counters.
Resolute rising supplies a deliberate break from passive group repetition.
Pairing supplies a small interpersonal setting for checking the claim.
Solitary examination removes collective reinforcement.
Repeated inward turning supplies the actual evidentiary process.
Long companionship supplies close, available knowledge of the accused person.
The alleged covering of reason is the specific label subjected to close inspection.

structural_cues: 34:46 answers the madness accusation by commanding standing in twos and singly, reflection, and attention to 'your companion.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies small-scale standing, reflection, companionship, and the madness denial; I infer a designed reduction of social and observational distance. A live alternative is that pair-and-single language concerns sincerity alone, not evidence gathering.

changed_reading.before: Distance simply condemns the speakers' lack of access.
changed_reading.after: Distance is remediable earlier by a discipline of close inspection: break the crowd into pairs and individuals, reflect, and test the label against the companion actually known.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same casting verb is predicated first of the Lord with stable truth as its carried content and complete knowledge of hidden domains; guidance then comes through concealed disclosure from one who hears and is near. Human casting at the unseen from afar is thereby exposed as an inverted imitation with the wrong agent, content, access, and position.

activation_trace.role: Human projection supplies one side of the repeated verb's contrast.
The hidden domain is what humans target without access.
Divine projection supplies the formally matching action with a different epistemic basis.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies what the divine action carries.
Full disclosure to the knower supplies authorized access.
Plural hidden domains lie within that knowledge rather than beyond it.
Knowledge imparted covertly supplies the legitimate bridge from hidden source to guided recipient.
Hearing supplies receptive contact rather than speculative projection.
Nearness locates the source of guidance opposite the focus speakers' remoteness.

structural_cues: 34:48 says the Lord casts with truth and knows hidden domains; 34:50 attributes guidance to revelation and closes with hearing and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated casting verb, changed object, hidden knowledge, revelation, and nearness; I infer a deliberate authorized/counterfeit reversal. A live alternative is that the two castings share forceful arrival but are not presented as imitation.

changed_reading.before: Human speakers make forceful claims about what they cannot see.
changed_reading.after: Their act is the counterfeit inverse of divine casting: truth is projected from actual hidden knowledge and near communication, whereas they project hidden content from remoteness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence opposes capture from a near place to an impossible extended grasp from a far place, then repeats the far-place formula with casting. Throwing at the unseen and reaching for late belief become paired remote-contact gestures: both try to overcome by projection a distance that prior rejection has made decisive.

activation_trace.role: Failure to escape or outrun reach supplies the asymmetry of the near seizure.
Capture supplies successful contact from the judging side.
The repeated locative noun fixes the first side of the spatial pattern.
Nearness makes capture immediate and inescapable.
Extending to take or attain supplies the attempted remote grasp.
The same locative frame links failed reaching to the focus casting.
Distance blocks the late attempt to attain belief's benefit.
Throwing supplies the earlier remote-contact strategy now exposed by the failed grasp.

structural_cues: 34:51 has seizure from a near place; 34:52 denies attainment from a far place; 34:53 repeats 'from a far place' for casting at the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near capture, failed extended grasp from afar, and repeated far-place casting; I infer that grasping and throwing are paired contact gestures with opposite directions. A live alternative is that 34:52 concerns only lateness in time and does not define the action in 34:53.

changed_reading.before: The far-place phrase only describes poor epistemic vantage.
changed_reading.after: It names a failed contact regime: they once tried to reach hidden reality by throwing claims outward, and later try to pull belief's benefit back from the same unbridgeable distance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final verse converts remoteness into an interposed barrier and identifies the earlier interior state as unsettled, agitating doubt. The focus's forceful projectiles are thus not expressions of certainty but compensations launched from doubt; repeated refusal lets that unstable distance harden into irreversible separation.

activation_trace.role: The prior time marker connects the focus refusal to the earlier pattern invoked again at the close.
Current non-proximity supplies the condition that the next verse intensifies.
An intervening obstacle turns distance into blocked access.
Separation between parties gives the barrier its relational structure.
Earlier counterparts extend the mechanism backward as a repeated historical outcome.
Unsettled interpenetration of alternatives identifies the state beneath their categorical speech.
Agitated suspicion adds affective instability to that doubt.

structural_cues: 34:54 immediately follows the focus with a barrier between them and what they desire, comparison to earlier peers, and the diagnosis of disturbing doubt.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distance, an ensuing barrier, historical repetition, and troubled doubt; I infer hardening from unstable remoteness to blocked access. A live alternative is that the barrier is only punishment after the fact and does not describe the psychology of 34:53.

changed_reading.before: Their distant assertions sound like overconfident certainty.
changed_reading.after: The force of the assertions can mask agitated doubt; maintained refusal turns that unstable distance into a barrier through which neither evidence nor belated desire can pass.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a locative noun branch of ك ف ر inside a verbal occurrence. It remains anchored by the focus's explicit place-and-distance construction and the same root's remoteness image; downstream prose should present it only as a material-spatial echo, not as a replacement translation of كَفَرُوا.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كَفَرُوا, مَكَانٍ, and بَعِيدٍ permit denial itself to be imaged as the isolated terrain from which speech emerges.

activation_trace.role: An inhabited place cut off from people supplies a spatial body for the condition of denial.
Explicit place lets that form-distant image attach to the syntax.
Remoteness confirms isolation as the governing spatial relation.
Verbal attack is what issues from this isolated terrain.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is an act committed before the remote speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disbelief has become the remote terrain itself: an isolated habitat from which accusatory speech is launched.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a specialized penetrating-thrust branch of ح ق ق in 34:48. It remains valid as a cross-material contrast anchored by the repeated ق ذ ف verb; downstream prose should qualify it as trajectory imagery, not claim that حَقّ literally means a weapon here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated يَقْذِفُ/يَقْذِفُونَ permits the carried material in 34:48 to test the trajectory imagined in 34:53.

activation_trace.role: Divine throwing supplies a trajectory formally parallel to the focus action.
A straight thrust that reaches through its target supplies penetration and aligned impact.
Human throwing supplies the comparison trajectory.
The target's concealment deprives the human trajectory of a visible line.
Distance compounds the absence of alignment and contact.

changed_reading.before: Divine truth and human conjecture are simply opposite contents carried by the same verb.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the contrast is ballistic: truth has an aligned, penetrating trajectory, while human speech is fired toward a concealed target from beyond contact.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes eschatological argument as projectile ricochet. It remains anchored in the focus's verbal-throwing branch and 34:31's explicit returning of speech from one group to another; downstream prose should mark it as a social-mechanical analogy rather than a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The verbal branch of يَقْذِفُونَ can be tracked through the reciprocal blame scene where speech is returned between groups.

activation_trace.role: Accusatory speech supplies the projectile whose social path is being traced.
Returning an answer or utterance supplies the rebound between speakers.
Back-and-forth speech over responsibility supplies the reciprocal channel of the rebound.

changed_reading.before: They cast assertions outward at an unseen object.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, accusatory casting also ricochets through the community: responsibility is fired toward leaders and followers and returned without closing the underlying distance.

strongest_changes: 34:48 reverses the focus exactly: the Lord casts stable truth while knowing hidden domains, whereas humans cast at the hidden from afar.
34:51-53 turns casting into one of two failed remote-contact gestures, paired with impossible attainment from a far place and opposed to near capture.
34:15-19 makes distance produced history: ingratitude requests separation and ends in social and narrative fragmentation.
34:20-21 shows how conjectural projectiles gain force through following despite possessing no compelling authority.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made place and distance simultaneously epistemic, historical, social, and terminal. Repeated casting, produced travel distance, elite insulation, close reflective testing, near revelation, failed remote grasp, and the final barrier prevent the focus from collapsing into a generic statement about guessing.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction بِٱلْغَيْبِ can support topic, instrument, or directional-target nuances, so the projectile mechanism should not force only one syntactic relation.
The facing/reception activations of ق ب ل and the remote-terrain activation of ك ف ر are form-distant and must remain exploratory.
The Saba sequence clearly mirrors produced distance, but whether it is a direct genealogy for 34:53 or a strong thematic analogy remains open.
The verbal-attack and physical-projectile branches of ق ذ ف coexist; downstream prose should preserve rather than prematurely resolve them.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Earlier covering is paired with distant verbal projection.** `ك ف ر/B001` is covering, `ق ب ل/B002` priorness, `ق ذ ف/B002` throwing words as accusation, and `ب ع د/B001` remoteness. Prior rejection supplies the temporal condition; accusations about the unseen are cast from spatial distance. Covering blocks reception, while verbal throwing substitutes projection for contact. The packet supplies both distances; I infer that lack of proximity makes speculation ballistic rather than evidential. The ayah reads their former discourse as claims launched across an unbridged gap.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:54 converted distant verbal casting into blocked desire: projection had crossed the gap only in speech, while effective reach remained impossible.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Remote conjecture as an unguided verbal projectile.** `ق ذ ف B002` supplies throwing words as accusation or abuse, `ق ذ ف B003` remoteness as being cast far, and `غ ي ب B006` uncertainty or doubt. The same root in 34:48 casts truth from the knower of hidden things; here the speakers cast at the hidden from a far place. The branches assign their words projectile force but no informed direction. The packet supplies the lexical repetition and reversed source-object relation; I infer that distance plus uncertainty makes the cast unguided. Their prior disbelief and late assertion read as one continuing epistemic habit.

2. **Prior rejection becomes present remoteness.** `ق ب ل B002` supplies priorness, while `ب ع د B002` supplies afterness and `ب ع د B001` spatial remoteness. The ayah links what they did before to where they now speak from. The branches assign temporal priority the cause-side and spatial distance the outcome-side. The packet supplies juxtaposition; I infer that sustained rejection produces the remote position from which their speech cannot reach its object. Distance reads as accumulated history, not location alone.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 34:54 named `شَكٍّ مُّرِيبٍ` as the enduring condition behind the remote cast. That final diagnosis sharpened `غ ي ب B006`: uncertainty is not incidental noise but the state from which their projectile speech was launched.

baseline.text: Oysa daha önce onu inkâr etmişler ve uzak bir yerden görülmeyen hakkında tahminler savurmuşlardı.

findings.text: Görülmeyene uzaktan savrulan sözler, güçlü fakat yönsüz mermiler gibidir; bilgiye dayalı yakın iletişimin yerini belirsizlik içinden yapılan tahmin alır.
Önceki inkâr, şimdi konuşulan uzak konumu üretir; mekânsal erişimsizlik zaman içinde birikmiş reddin sonucudur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P4: Deferred Belief Becomes a Geometry of Capture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Once panic arrives, the former freedom to defer is translated into spatial relations: seizure is near, belief is sought from far away, speculative speech is projected toward the unseen, and a barrier closes access to desire.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The `ق ذ ف` field reverses the effective projection of truth in 34:48 into distant verbal throwing at the unseen in 34:53, making distance a difference in epistemic warrant.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Belated Reach and Distant Projection
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Belief is asserted after the decisive moment, but grasping from afar fails while unsupported speech is thrown toward what remains unseen.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: reaching or taking hold (`quranic:root_001565:B001/m01`), remoteness (`quranic:root_000131:B001/m01`), assent of belief (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`), verbal accusation or casting (`quranic:root_001209:B002/m01`), distance extended like travel (`quranic:root_001209:B003/m01`), the unseen (`quranic:root_001117:B001/m01`)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The problem is no longer lack of verbal assent but loss of reach. Earlier conjectural projection toward the unseen has produced the very remoteness from which valid belief cannot now be grasped.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi örtme ve görünmez kılma çekirdeğini; zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme, külün toprakla kapanması ve yıldızların güneş ışığında görünmemesi gibi gerçekleşmelerle açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel örtmedir; dinî inkâr, nimeti yadsıma ve günahı giderme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın örtme çekirdeğini korur; zırh, silah, kül ve gök cisimleriyle ilgili kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak ayrılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin üstünü kapatarak onu görünmez veya örtülü duruma getirme işlemi.
Zırhı giysiyle kaplama, silahla örtünme ve külün üstünün toprakla kapanması çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar örtme ve kapatma çekirdeğinde birleşir; farklı örnekler bu işlemin nesne, giysi, silah, kül ve gök görünümü üzerindeki gerçekleşmelerini gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı inancın karşıtı ve gerçeğin örtülmesi olarak tanımlar; birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği yadsıma ile inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma türlerini açıkça içerir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dinî gerçeği ve inancı reddetmeyle sınırlıdır; nimeti yadsıma veya yalnızca genel bir gerçeği inkâr etme bunun tamamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dinî reddetme çekirdeği korunur; kalben bilip söylememe, bilip kabul etmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille reddetme yapıya bağlı türlerdir.

concept_map.definition: İnancı, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddederek dinî gerçeği örtmek ya da kabul etmemektir. Kaynaklar bunu inkâr, bile bile direnme, ikiyüzlülük, ortak koşma ve yalanlama gibi türlere ayırır.

facets.statement: İnancın karşıtı olarak dinî gerçeği, birliği, dinî hükmü veya peygamberliği reddetme.
Kalben bilip sözle kabul etmeme, bilip boyun eğmeme, dıştan inanmış görünme ve hem kalple hem dille inkâr etme farklı türlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı inancın karşıtı sayar ve gerçeği örtme düşüncesiyle açıklar; toplu aktarım çeşitli inkâr, direnme ve ikiyüzlülük biçimlerini de sıralar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnancın karşıtı olan çekirdeği ve reddedilen dinî içeriği birlikte ifade eder.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî gerçeği kabul etmeme çekirdeğini ve inanç karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dalın genel dinî karşıtlık bağlamında eylem olarak çevrilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İnancı kabul etmeme ve ona karşı durma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bile bile yadsıma veya direnme türünün açıklandığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi ile dışa vurulan ret arasındaki ayrımı korur.
error_profile.loses: İkiyüzlülük ve bütünüyle bilgisiz inkâr gibi öteki türleri dışarıda bırakır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kalben bildiği gerçeği diliyle kabul etmeme
gerçeği bildiği hâlde inatla kabul etmemek
gerçeği hem kalple hem dille inkâr etmek

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle dinî inancı ve gerçeği reddeder; ikiyüzlülük ve ortak koşma gibi türleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, doğruluğu bilinen herhangi bir şeyi inkâr etmeyi din alanıyla sınırlamadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bilinen bir gerçeği kabul etmeme iki dalın ortak alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın dinî kapsamı ve birden çok tutum türü vardır; komşu dal ise konusu ne olursa olsun bilgiye rağmen yadsımayı merkez alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal dinî gerçeği kabul etmemeyi ve reddetmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal haberi veya dinî gerçeği doğrulayıp kalben benimsemeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı kabul-ret ekseninde dinî veya doğrulanabilir içerikle ilişki kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri gerçeği reddetme, diğeri onu doğrulayıp benimseme yönündedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel yadsıma en yakın anlam komşusu, inanma ise açık karşıt kutup olduğu için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفر نقيض الإيمان وجحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة والإنكار والجحود والمعاندة والنفاق والشرك والتكذيب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كفران النعمة وحده ولا البراءة ولا التكفير عن السيئات
branches.source_phrase_ar: الكفر ضد الإيمان سمى لأنه تغطية الحق (maqayis)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان والكفر أربعة أنحاء كفر الجحود وكفر المعاندة وكفر النفاق وكفر الإنكار (ayn)؛ الكفر ضد الإيمان (sihah)؛ الكفر نقيض الإيمان وكفر إنكار وكفر جحود وكفر معاندة وكفر نفاق وكفر هو شرك وكفر بكتاب الله ورسوله والتكذيب بالله (tahdhib)؛ أعظم الكفر جحود الوحدانية أو الشريعة أو النبوة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nimeti yadsımayı, onu örtmeyi ve gereği olan şükrü yerine getirmemeyi aynı çekirdekte birleştirir; dalın geçici çerçevesi bu koşulu doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesne özellikle nimettir ve belirleyici sonuç şükrün terkidir; genel dinî ret bu dala kendiliğinden girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Nimeti yadsıma çekirdeği yalın ve türemiş kullanımlarda korunur; nimetle kurulan yapı ve aşırılık bildiren kişi nitelemesi ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir.

concept_map.definition: Bir nimeti tanımamak, değerini örtmek veya onun gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemektir. Bu tutumda aşırı olan kişi de aynı anlam alanında nitelenir.

facets.statement: Bir nimeti yadsıma veya şükrünü yerine getirmeyerek değerini örtme.
Nimetleri sürekli ve aşırı biçimde yadsıyan kişi bu tutumun yoğunlaşmış taşıyıcısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar nimeti yadsımayı şükrün karşıtı sayar; örtme açıklaması, nimetin gerektirdiği şükrü yerine getirmemeyi bu karşıtlığın belirleyici davranışı yapar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nimeti tanımama ile ona şükretmeme çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Nimetin inkâr edilmesini ve şükrün terk edilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nimetin veya yapılan iyiliğin tanınmadığı gündelik bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapılan iyiliği tanımama ve karşılığında şükretmeme tutumunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: nimeti yadsımak ve şükrünü yerine getirmemek
iyilikleri karşılıksız ve teşekkürsüz kalan cömert adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimetin yadsınmasını ve şükrünün terkini doğrudan çekirdek yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nimet yanında dostluğu kesme, felaketleri sayıp nimetleri unutma ve yardımı esirgeme gibi tutumları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Nimeti tanımama ve ona şükretmeme iki dalda da merkezîdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal nankörlüğü daha geniş bir davranış kümesine yayar; bu dal doğrudan nimet ile şükür arasındaki ilişkiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal nimeti tanımamayı ve şükrünü terk etmeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal nimeti tanımayı, övmeyi ve şükrü sözle ya da davranışla göstermeyi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal nimetin tanınması ve karşılığının verilmesi eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri nimetin değerini örter ve şükrü bırakır; diğeri nimeti tanır ve şükrü gösterir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; daha geniş nankörlük dalı yakın eş, şükür dalı ise doğrudan karşıt kutup olarak yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه كفر النعمة وكفرانها وجحودها وترك شكرها والكفور في كفران النعمة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözün bir şeyden uzak olduğunu bildirme, onunla bağını reddetme ve ondan sıyrılma anlamında kullanılabildiğini açıkça söyler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir inancı yadsımak değil, belirli bir şeyle bağı reddedip ondan uzaklaşmaktır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca bir şeyden uzaklaşmayı bildiren bağlı yapıda korunur; yalın köke genel bir ayrılma anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyle olan bağı reddetmek, ondan uzak olduğunu açıklamak ve sorumluluk ya da aidiyet bağından sıyrılmaktır.

facets.statement: Belirli bir şeyle bağı reddederek ondan uzaklaşma ve kendini onun dışında tutma.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bağlı kullanımın bir şeyden uzak olduğunu ilan etme ve onunla ilişkiden sıyrılma anlamı taşıdığında birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, görüş, eylem veya sorumlulukla ilişkiyi açıkça reddeden bağlı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bağı reddetme ile o bağdan uzaklaşma işlemlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aidiyet veya sorumluluk bağının reddedildiği bağlamlarda açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aidiyet bağını reddetme ve kendini dışarıda konumlandırma sonucunu korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir şeyle bağını reddedip ondan uzaklaşmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir bağlı söz yapısında ilişkiyi reddetmeyi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişi, iş, kusur ve kötülükten arınma, uzak durma, uyarma ve mazeret bildirme gibi daha geniş bir alanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişi veya şeyle ilişkiyi reddetme ve ondan uzak durma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yapısal olarak bağlı ve dar bir ilişki reddidir; komşu dal genel uzaklık, arınmışlık ve sorumsuzluk bildirimlerini de içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel bağ kesme ve uzak durma dalı en yakın anlam sınırını verdiği için yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكفر بمعنى البراءة والتنصل من الشيء أو بعضهم من بعض

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişiyi inançsız diye adlandırma ve onun inancı reddettiğine hükmetme işlemlerini doğrudan verir; geçici çerçeve bu katılımcı ilişkisini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Eylem kişinin kendi reddi değil, başka bir kişinin durumu hakkında adlandırma veya hüküm vermedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin ettirgen-hüküm verici anlamı korunur; suçlama veya zorlama gibi başka yapısal anlamlar eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiyi inançsız diye adlandırmak veya onun dinî gerçeği reddettiğine hükmetmektir.

facets.statement: Başka bir kişiyi inançsız diye niteleme veya bu yönde hüküm verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar eylemi bir kişiye inançsız nitelemesi yöneltmek veya onun hakkında bu hükmü vermek olarak açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir başkasını dinî inancı reddeden kişi diye adlandırma veya böyle hükmetme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Başka bir kişi hakkında niteleme ve hüküm verme işlemini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Resmî veya öğretisel bir hükmün vurgulandığı bağlamlarda daha açık karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin dinî durumu hakkında hüküm verme yönünü açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birini inançsız saymak veya öyle adlandırmak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bir kişinin dinî inancı reddettiğine ilişkin niteleme veya hüküm verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişiye hırsızlık eylemini yükler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda konuşan, başka bir kişiye olumsuz bir nitelik veya eylem isnat eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İsnat yapısı ortaktır; ancak yüklenen içerik ve hükmün dinî niteliği bütünüyle farklıdır, bu yüzden olağan ikame mümkün değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişiyi baskıyla itaatsizliğe sürükleme sürecini açıkça belirtir; geçici çerçeve başlangıç durumu, zorlama ve sonuç ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel zorlama değildir; itaat eden kişinin zorlanarak itaatsizliğe geçirilmesi şarttır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim, itaat eden kişiyi itaatsizliğe zorlama anlamıyla sınırlanır; yalnızca hüküm verme anlamına veya genel baskıya genişletilmez.

facets.statement: İtaat eden bir kişiyi zorlayarak itaatsizliğe geçirmek.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı katılımcı değişimini verir: itaat eden kişi dış baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya mecbur bırakılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Başlangıçta itaat eden bir kişinin baskıyla itaatsiz davranmaya sürüklendiği bağlam için tam karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Zorlama işlemini, başlangıçtaki itaati ve itaatsizlik sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İtaatsizliğin açık bir başkaldırı olarak gerçekleştiği anlatı bağlamlarında kullanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi istemediği bir davranışa baskıyla mecbur bırakma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın başlangıç ve sonuç koşulları belirgindir; komşu dalın zorlama çekirdeğinde itaatten itaatsizliğe geçiş şartı yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sonucu doğrudan baskı ve mecbur bırakma yoluyla oluşturur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayartma, aldatma veya isteği süsleme yoluyla doğru yoldan saptırmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir kişiyi önceki doğru veya itaatkâr durumundan uzaklaştırma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada belirleyici araç zorlamadır; komşu dalda ise yöneltme ve ayartma bulunabilir, mecbur bırakma zorunlu değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi çiftçinin tohumu veya taneyi toprakla örtme işlemini adlandırmanın gerekçesi yapar; tekil ve çoğul kişi adları aynı eyleyen rolünü taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın kişi adları, tohumu toprakla örten çiftçi anlamında tutulur; dinî kişi nitelemesine veya genel ekim sürecine genişletilmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kişiyi yalnızca meslek adıyla değil, tohumu toprakla örtme gerekçesiyle birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Çiftçi rolünü ve tohumu toprakla örtme işlemini birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Toprağı işleyip ekim yapan kişi rolünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Tohumu örtme işiyle sınırlandırılmayan bütün çiftçilik faaliyetlerini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Tohumun toprağa verilmesi ve çiftçinin bu süreçteki rolü iki dalda ortaktır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gönderimi ekim yapan çiftçidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; ekim süreci ile genel çiftçi adı, eylem ve eyleyen sınırını açıkladığı için yayımlandı.
